text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Guess what? I've decided on my target race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Training was progressing smoothly, and one day, as her body was becoming conditioned enough to withstand fierce races...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I was thinking it was time to decide on a target race and set a schedule, she contacted me herself.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I want to run in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
When I saw the race...
my heart fluttered so much.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The way everyone ran was truly beautiful
and filled with pride.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I used to think any race would do as long as I could run,
but for the first time, I felt, "I want to run this race!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... I'm sure
there's something special about that race.
I want to find out what it is!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And besides, I'm sure this will be great news to report back to everyone in my homeland.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The "me" of today wouldn't exist if everyone hadn't forgiven and cheered for me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: To express my gratitude to everyone, I want to bring pride back home.
choice_data_list: Then our main goal is set for the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
Then our main goal is set for the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Our ultimate goal? ...Ah, right.
That race is still quite a ways off, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What kind of rotation
do they normally run?
choice_data_list: Looks like a lot of girls will be running the Triple Tiara route.
I wonder if a lot of girls will be running the Triple Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara route consists of the Oka Sho, the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.
These are exceptionally glamorous races that can only be run during the Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see! Maybe I should do that too, then?
After all, that's the "royal road" to success, right?♪
choice_data_list: It's fine to take on the challenge, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having not originally planned to run in races,
she began serious training much later than the other girls.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suggested that rather than pushing herself in spring
when differences in ability show easily, she could train through summer
and debut in the autumn instead.
choice_data_list: I'll leave the decision to you, Fine.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then there's only one answer!
Of course I want to run in the spring season!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"If I can run in the race,
I want to take on the challenge!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Besides! That "even more amazing" wonderful view... you can see it from a grand stage, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
My heart can race even more.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: A beautiful view, huh...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You weren't lying when you said it would be even more amazing than what I'm seeing now, were you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I want to know more.
Everything there is to experience in a race!
choice_data_list: There's definitely a joy here you can't experience anywhere else.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu, then it's decided♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll... run the Triple Tiara route,
and take on the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!
choice_data_list: First up is the spring Oka Sho!
First up is the spring Oka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the next target race was decided: the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Spring, huh... It'll probably go by in a flash.
We have to cherish every moment of it."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, when are we doing our cherry blossom viewing?
If we plant a sakura tree in the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Of course, I wasn't being serious, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I wasn't being serious, though...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Aha, you caught me.
Yeees♪
